The cited risk lemma does more than assert abstract L2 convergence. Its Proof 1.1 sets c_j=lambda_j q_alpha(lambda_j) theta_j and d_j=sigma s_j q_alpha(lambda_j), proves sum c_j^2 and sum d_j^2 finite, then uses monotone convergence and Markov to obtain sum d_j^2 xi_j^2 < infinity almost surely. Orthogonality gives convergence of the full series sum (c_j+d_j xi_j)v_j on that event, and the explicit expected tail formula proves that same pointwise limit is the L2 estimator. The observed sums are exactly these sums because y_j=s_j theta_j+sigma xi_j. Intersecting the finitely many candidate events proves the agreement cited in theorem Proof 1.1.
